events.summary: Upper Swat floods. A 2010 hotel rebuild was raised in 2022 coverage, but the 2010 damage totals are not verified in this build.

facts.text: Hotels destroyed in the 2010 floods were reported as rebuilt on the same sites.
facts.source: The Friday Times, News Desk, 30 Aug 2022

events.summary: Monsoon floods in Swat. Rescue and relief work was under way in Kumrat, Kalam and Kanju by late August 2022.

facts.text: Rescue and relief operations were under way in Kumrat, Kalam and Kanju, with aerial reconnaissance over several Swat areas.
facts.source: The Friday Times, News Desk, 30 Aug 2022 (no figures given)
